_note: Interest received on compensation or enhanced compensation is income from other sources, charged in full; half of it is then deducted by OS-COMPENSATION-INTEREST (D-321). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.92(2)(i) "any income by way of interest received on compensation or on enhanced compensation" (p.138). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.56(2)(viii) (thc p.308), inserted by the Finance (No. 2) Act, 2009 s.26 (w.e.f. 1-4-2010). In RS-OS-INCOME, by othersources.kind. Provenance and introducedBy are OS-COMPENSATION-INTEREST's, whose instruments insert both clauses. Every regime.
